title: Layout
description: full = title, artist, difficulty, progress with mods, star rating and BPM, plus the difficulty settings. compact = title, difficulty, progress and one line of star rating and BPM.

title: Orientation
description: auto = a strip when the page is at least 2.2× wider than tall (e.g. under the taiko lane), otherwise a column. Type scales to the page size either way.

title: Alignment
description: Which edge the content hugs (mirrors the layout). auto = right for osu!, catch and taiko (right-edge placements), left for mania (left corner).

title: Original-language titles
description: Show the title and artist in their original script (titleUnicode / artistUnicode) when the map has them.

title: Difficulty settings
description: Full layout: AR/CS/OD/HP for the ruleset being played (taiko OD/HP, catch AR/CS/HP, mania OD/HP). Mod-adjusted values show the original first: 9→10.33.

title: Backing
description: none = text floats on the game with a contrast shadow. scrim = a soft dark glow that fades out. panel = a graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map = progress, star and rate colour tinted from the map's background (Material 3 tonal spot; grey backgrounds fall back to amber). 18-lab = always amber.
